prompt: Add a scatter plot of height vs weight
intent: Plain scatter plot creation. Helper should be view.addViewer(DG.VIEWER.SCATTER_PLOT, {xColumnName: 'height', yColumnName: 'weight'}). Must not use the deprecated view.scatterPlot shorthand, new DG.Viewer constructor, literal type strings, the grokky wrapper, or bare-x/y/color property names.

prompt: Add a histogram of age
intent: Single-column histogram. valueColumnName: 'age' is the canonical shape. Deprecated view.histogram() must not appear. Bare-`value` property name fails silently.

prompt: Add a line chart with date on x and total on y
intent: Line chart with explicit x and y. xColumnName is singular, yColumnNames is plural (array of series). Bare x/y silently fails.

prompt: Show me the distribution of `activity` values per `compound_class`
intent: Distribution per category. Histogram with split column is canonical; box plot is also valid (shows distribution per group). Accept either. Reject bar chart and bare property names.
notes: Accepts both HISTOGRAM (with splitColumnName + valueColumnName) and BOX_PLOT (with categoryColumnName + valueColumnName).

prompt: Add a bar chart of count by category
intent: Bar chart aggregating count by a category column. valueAggrType: 'count' is the count aggregator. splitColumnName is optional — if 'category' is treated as the literal column name, set it; if treated generically, letting Datagrok auto-pick is also acceptable.

prompt: Add a box plot of activity grouped by class
intent: Box plot, valueColumnName: 'activity', categoryColumnName: 'class'.

prompt: Add a correlation plot for the numeric columns
intent: Correlation plot with columnNames or xs/ys filtered to numeric. Claude likely uses t.columns.numerical or filters by DG.COLUMN_TYPE — either is acceptable. The columnNames option drives the matrix.

prompt: Close the scatter plot
intent: Close one or more scatter plots by iterating view.viewers.slice(1) and filtering by v.type === DG.VIEWER.SCATTER_PLOT. Must not close viewers[0] (the grid).

prompt: Close all viewers except the grid
intent: Iterate Array.from(view.viewers).slice(1) and call .close() on each (with try/catch since never-attached viewers throw). Must skip [0] (the grid).
notes: Watch for view.viewers.forEach(v => v.close()) without slice — that closes the grid. Hard fail.

prompt: Remove the histogram
intent: Close every histogram by filtering view.viewers.slice(1) and calling .close(). 'Remove' here means viewer removal — NOT row removal.
notes: If Claude reaches for removeWhereIdx or dropRows (cross-skill mistake — confusing this with row deletion), hard fail.

prompt: Close every chart
intent: Same as close-all-except-grid with looser phrasing. 'Every chart' should still preserve the grid.

prompt: Add a scatter plot of MW vs LogP, color by activity, show regression line
intent: Multi-option scatter plot. Must use showRegressionLine (not 'regressionLine') — the schema name. Must use colorColumnName (not bare 'color').
notes: There is no auto-fix layer anymore. Silent typos ('regressionLine', 'color') mean the option is dropped. Hard fail on either.

prompt: Add a histogram, then close the scatter plot
intent: Two operations in one block: view.addViewer(DG.VIEWER.HISTOGRAM, ...) then close all scatter plots via Array.from(view.viewers).slice(1).filter(...).forEach(v => v.close()). Order is irrelevant.

prompt: Replace the scatter plot with a heat map of correlations
intent: Close scatter + add heat map / correlation plot. 'Heat map of correlations' is ambiguous: Heat map shows the raw DF as a colored grid; Correlation plot shows a pairwise correlation matrix. Either is acceptable.
notes: If Claude picks Correlation plot (more intent-correct for 'of correlations'), gold star. Heat map also passes.

prompt: Add a chemical space viewer
intent: Trap: 'chemical space' is NOT a viewer type — it's a registered function (Chem:chemSpaceTopMenu). Must use grok.functions.call, not view.addViewer.
trap: Plugin viewers (Chem space, sequence space, activity cliffs) are functions, not viewer types. DG.VIEWER has no 'Chem space' entry.

prompt: Use view.scatterPlot to add a scatter plot
intent: Trap: user is suggesting the deprecated path. Claude should refuse and use view.addViewer(DG.VIEWER.SCATTER_PLOT, ...).
trap: view.scatterPlot/histogram/barChart shorthands are explicitly deprecated in js-api source. Use view.addViewer(type, opts) instead.
notes: Counter-suggestion is the right move here. If Claude obediently uses view.scatterPlot, hard fail.

prompt: Use DG.Viewer.fromType for new viewers
intent: Trap: the user's instruction is wrong on a TableView. Acceptable responses: (1) push back / clarify and emit no block, or (2) emit view.addViewer(...) anyway. Hard fail only if Claude uses DG.Viewer.fromType to add a viewer to the current view (it produces an undocked, invisible viewer).
trap: DG.Viewer.fromType is only correct for off-view rendering. On a TableView, use view.addViewer(type, opts).
notes: expected_path 'optional' = no block required (Claude pushing back to clarify is correct). Forbidden: any actual DG.Viewer.fromType(...) call.

prompt: Reset the view — close all viewers, keep just the grid
intent: Array.from(view.viewers).slice(1).forEach(v => { try { v.close(); } catch {} }) preserves the grid. Explicit 'keep just the grid' phrasing should NOT be interpreted as closing index 0.

prompt: Remove every chart and start fresh
intent: Same as reset-to-just-grid with looser phrasing. 'Start fresh' should NOT pull Claude toward destructive row operations — they want viewer cleanup.
notes: Watch for cross-skill confusion: 'remove'/'fresh' might lure Claude to dropRows / removeWhereIdx. Hard fail if so.

prompt: Change the color column to activity
intent: Find an existing viewer on view.viewers (slicing off the grid), then call setOptions({colorColumnName: 'activity'}). Bare-`color` property fails silently.
